excluded_metadata.num_users: 用户规模横轴，不是待比较的结果指标。
excluded_metadata.seed_count: 有效训练种子数量；用于说明统计覆盖。
excluded_metadata.episodes: 每次评估的回合数，当前恒为 5。
excluded_metadata.trained_timesteps: 训练预算元数据，存在缺失且有效值恒定。
excluded_metadata.best_training_eval_reward: 只在部分方法中保存的模型选择记录，不能替代统一测试结果。
excluded_metadata.selected_offload: 仅单一基线保存的固定参数，不能形成跨方法比较。
excluded_metadata.load_variance_sample_count: 负载统计采样数量，不作为性能指标。

episode_conversion.rule: validated cumulative episodes; otherwise exact total_steps/max_steps on complete episodes
episode_conversion.partial_episodes: excluded, including the final 496-step HAN+PDQN/MADDPG records
episode_conversion.ppo_sampling: two-episode means at native even episode coordinates; no interpolation
episode_conversion.ppo_totals: divide recorded rollout totals by delta(total_steps)/mean_length (2 here)
episode_conversion.evaluation: exact fractional total_steps/max_steps; checkpoints beyond training budget excluded

confidence_interval.method: percentile bootstrap of whole seed trajectories

notes: All metrics retain their own native method sampling grids; no smoothing or cross-method interpolation.
Missing fields are omitted rather than filled with zeros; legend n is seed count, and detailed coverage is per panel.
Throughput is derived only from measured completed_tasks and total_user_seconds where both exist.
PDQN seed42 throughput lacks both source inputs and is omitted, leaving n=4 for that method.
Actor/critic losses, HAN gradients and exploration noise exclude trainer placeholders using actual network support.
Loss aggregation and recent-mean reward windows differ by trainer; these are recorded optimization diagnostics.
The current histories include promoted reruns at U20/seed43 and U30/seed45; bootstrap does not remove selection bias.

fields.elapsed_sec: incompatible timing intervals across trainer types
